cases.message: What is included in Glaze & Sip?
cases.reply:
Welcome to Petal & Crumb Atelier. 

Glaze & Sip is a 90-minute pottery-painting experience priced at USD 38 per person. It includes one ceramic piece, one drink, and one pastry. 

If you would like to reserve a seat, please let me know your name, email address, preferred date and time, and group size, and I will gladly collect those details for our team to confirm.
